answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the relic is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the atlas of a task receipt, and the sparrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit.
